recognize_zh: 大腸內視鏡影像可見多發性、表面平滑紅色的隆起結節與息肉樣病灶，部分表面有小糜爛或黃白色覆蓋物，腸腔尚通暢；多發息肉樣黏膜病灶是腸道惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的常見內視鏡表現之一，但無特異性。
features: Multiple sessile, smooth-surfaced nodular and polypoid mucosal elevations
Some nodules show small superficial erosions with yellow-white exudate
A discrete sessile polyp in the lower panel with lobulated surface
Lumen patent without circumferential stricture or large ulcerated mass
describe_en: Colonoscopic images (2014) show multiple sessile, smooth-surfaced nodular and polypoid elevations of the colonic mucosa, some with small superficial erosions covered by yellow-white exudate, and a separate lobulated sessile polyp. The lumen remains patent without a large ulcerated or stricturing mass. The endoscopic appearance is nonspecific; the multinodular pattern raises lymphomatous involvement, and biopsy with immunophenotyping is required. In this case, the findings correspond to mucosal involvement by indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: Endoscopically similar, but biopsy shows CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1-positive B cells rather than a CD3/CD8-positive T-cell infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Biopsy shows neoplastic follicles of CD10 and BCL2-positive B cells.
Histology shows dysplastic or serrated epithelium rather than lamina propria expansion by lymphocytes.
Background mucosa shows chronic active colitis with architectural distortion, and the infiltrate is polyclonal.
